race.comment: ROLLING MAGIC (10) was dominant first up when putting a big gap on them, then lost his punch last time when pushed forward, so expect a more patient ride from the wide draw. A hot early tempo sets it up perfectly for him to launch. RUN HARRY RUN (1) is as tough as they come and returned in terrific order with two strong wins, then kept ticking over with a Flemington jump out. Clark will punch him forward and give a great look. ALTHOFF (7) was arrogant here two weeks ago after having no luck fresh and he still has more to offer, so expect him to be charging late again for Lloyd. FULLY LIT (3) will inject plenty of speed and with that run under the belt he can take catching if left alone through the middle stages.
